finding: Before: latest delivered plan, with question text/relationship but no question identity. Now active referent first; bounded legacy history fallback remains for old saves.
Existing bounded delivered_exchanges (32 rows), exact speech, turn and sealed response digest. New referent ID links the question without duplicating authorized speech.
Stable active interlocutor/claim/lead/action slots exist, but represent other responsibilities; no correction lineage or missing question argument.
NPC speech commitments and their epistemics remain separately owned; referents create no promises.
Existing proposition identity describes authorized speech/content. A player question needs independent identity even when no answer exists.
Verified speech remains subject to disclosure checks; referent existence is not a truth or permission record.
Existing CLARIFY/EXECUTE decisions and pending context remain. New accepted unresolved questions carry clarification answer_status; malformed proposals preserve previous focus.
Existing lexical/topic anchors support legacy prompting. They cannot replace an accepted unified referent.
Existing binary proposition/evidence schema is reused, not a second world or source fact store.
Session persistence envelopes already preserve conversational_context; no separate save format or migration engine needed.
Separate compact index holds intent metadata and links existing delivery identity/digest; necessary because unknown speech is not a stable question.
